## Ctx.renderCallbackAnswer() method

Answers the active callback query with template text.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderCallbackAnswer(showAlert: boolean, data: IData | null | undefined, AGBaseId: string, options?: IOptCallbackAnswer | null): Promise<true>;
```

True on success.

## Remarks

Template-backed counterpart to answering inline-button taps: the `<g-callback-answer>` block supplies the notification text (multilang via `data`<!-- -->), shown either as a toast or as an alert. There is no message to send, so this takes no keyboard and never falls back to a reply.

Observe-only send-error coverage (mirrors `renderDice`<!-- -->): failures are classified via `Ctx.classifySendError`<!-- -->, reported to `notifySendError`<!-- -->, and logged (`retryable` → `log.error`<!-- -->, `fallback-text` → `log.warn`<!-- -->). After notify+log the original error is ALWAYS rethrown untouched.

Toast text is limited by Telegram to 200 characters — keep the block short.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackQueryData() {
  await this.renderCallbackAnswer(false, undefined, `tap-card`)
}
```
